display.label: Storage Table
display.description: Azure Storage Table for NoSQL structured key-value data storage within an Azure Storage Account

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Storage Table within the storage account. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Storage Table settings and storage account association.

fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: Name of the Storage Table. Must be 3-63 characters, start with a letter, and contain only alphanumeric characters.

validation.pattern_error: Table name must be 3-63 characters, start with a letter, and contain only alphanumeric characters.

fields.label: Storage Account ID
fields.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Storage Account where the table should reside.

sections.label: Access Control Lists (ACLs)
sections.description: Optional stored access policies for Shared Access Signature (SAS) delegation. Requires Shared Key authentication enabled on the Storage Account.

fields.label: Stored Access Policies
fields.description: List of Stored Access Policies defining permissions and expiry for the table.

fields.label: Policy Identifier
fields.description: Unique identifier for the stored access policy (up to 64 characters).

fields.label: Access Policy
fields.description: Permissions and time window for this stored access policy.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.description: Permissions for the policy. Combination of 'r' (read), 'w' (write), 'd' (delete), and 'l' (list).
